description: This Java source file defines an abstract test class 'BaseContextMockTest' used for setting up mocked 'UserContext' and 'ContextMockHelper' objects for testing purposes in the OpenMRS core project. It includes annotations and setup/teardown methods to facilitate unit testing with Mockito and JUnit.

classes.name: BaseContextMockTest
classes.description: An abstract test class that provides mocked 'UserContext' and 'ContextMockHelper' for subclasses to facilitate unit testing in OpenMRS.

methods.name: initMocks
methods.description: Initializes Mockito annotations to create mock objects for fields annotated with @Mock before each test.

methods.name: revertContextMocks
methods.description: Reverts the mocks applied to 'ContextMockHelper' after each test to clean up the testing environment.
